issue.standard_remedy: Harmonize prices to the best plant / global agreement
issue.summary: Pays 9.8% on average above the best plant for the same materials

plan.diagnosis: Detroit, MI plant pays 9.8% premium versus best-plant pricing across 237 materials sourced from Meridian Industrial US in SAP ECC 6.0, resulting in USD 3,356,253 excess spend over the trailing 12 months. Root cause is lack of price harmonization and absence of centralized contract enforcement in SAP for this supplier across plants.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct joint benchmarking session with Meridian Industrial US and best-plant procurement lead to validate pricing delta on all 237 materials and negotiate price alignment to best-plant rates
remedy_steps.owner: Detroit Plant Procurement Manager & Category Lead

remedy_steps.step: Execute global pricing amendment with Meridian Industrial US to lock best-plant pricing for Detroit across all 237 materials, targeting 9.8% reduction
Update SAP ECC 6.0 INFO records for all 237 materials at Detroit plant with harmonized pricing and link to central contract (ME11/ME12)
Implement SAP source list (ME01) for Detroit plant mandating Meridian Industrial US materials reference central contract, blocking non-compliant POs
remedy_steps.owner: SAP Master Data Team & Detroit Procurement

remedy_steps.step: Establish monthly price variance reporting in SAP (ME2L/ME2N) comparing Detroit vs. best-plant for Meridian Industrial US to monitor compliance

plan.expected_impact: Price harmonization will eliminate the 9.8% premium, delivering USD 3,356,253 in annual savings for Detroit plant.
kpis: Price variance vs. best plant (target: 0% delta on 237 materials)
Realized savings tracked monthly (target: USD 279,688 per month)
PO compliance rate to harmonized INFO records (target: 100%)
risks: Meridian Industrial US may resist price reduction for Detroit; mitigation is to consolidate volume commitment across plants as leverage
Detroit plant may have different delivery terms or order quantities justifying premium; validation required in Week 1-3 benchmarking
SAP INFO record updates may be overridden by manual PO pricing; enforce source list and PO approval workflow to prevent
Best-plant pricing may have expired or changed; confirm current validity before negotiation
erp_actions: Update 237 material INFO records in SAP ECC 6.0 (ME12) for Detroit plant with best-plant pricing effective contract date
Create source list entries (ME01) for Detroit plant linking all 237 Meridian Industrial US materials to central contract number with fixed vendor flag
Configure release strategy for Detroit POs >USD 5,000 with Meridian Industrial US requiring category approval if price exceeds INFO record (ME28)
Add central contract reference in SAP vendor master (XK02) for Meridian Industrial US to enforce contract visibility
Schedule monthly ME2N extract for Detroit-Meridian Industrial US spend with price variance column vs. contract baseline
